note: Both pages were throwaway `?probe=` branches in webApp's Main.kt, reverted after the run.

pointerType.page: ?probe=pointer — a full-screen Box whose pointerInput reports every change
pointerType.caveat: Input.dispatchMouseEvent with pointerType touch still arrives as PointerType.Mouse, so the touch half of this reading is the harness, not the platform. Only the mouse half is a measurement.

selectionWash.page: ?probe=select — a SelectionContainer over one line, LocalTextSelectionColors forced to #FF00FF
selectionWash.washRows: 24..49, which is the row the glyphs are drawn on
